message:
GET /rest/v1/sessions?updated_at=gt.2026-09-04T16:17:44.655608%2B00:00&select=*&limit=1000&offset=0 -> HTTP 401 {"code":"PGRST303","details":null,"hint":null,"message":"JWT issued at future"}

This machine's clock is ahead of Supabase's, so the token it signs looks like it was issued in the future and is rejected. Set the clock (Windows: Settings > Time & language > Date & time > Sync now). Nothing is wrong with the key or the data.
